title: The ordinary constant-object unit as an adjunction unit
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. Write $C_T=A_T[0]$, let $c_f:Lf^*C_Y\cong C_X$ be ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], let $\eta_f:C_Y\to Rf_*C_X$ be supportedDerivedUnit [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system], and let $u_f$ be the unit of the specified derived adjunction $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$. Then $\eta_f=(u_f)_{C_Y};Rf_*(c_f.\mathrm{hom})$.

theorem supportedDerivedUnit_eq_adjunction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    supportedDerivedUnit A f =
      (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).unit.app
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A f).map (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom
